title: Review prompt still reads no checks a minute on as no CI
notes:
**[low]** [out-of-scope] The review prompt still holds the rule this change retires. `src/main/ship/review.ts:136-138` (the report path, merging off) tells the review worker that "no checks reported" a minute on means "the repository run[s] no CI".

What happens: in a repository with workflows whose CI never started on the head commit (the case command-decision-7 records), a review with merging off reports "converged, ready to merge" with the CI state "no CI". The user merges it unchecked, the same outcome `pr land` now refuses. The two paths now disagree about one fact.

Out of scope because `review.ts` is untouched and the prompt predates this change. It belongs in the follow-up: word step 2 of the report path the way the land's refusal reads ("still none, in a repository with workflows, is CI that did not start; say so"), and update ship-decision-2, which says the same thing.

Issue: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/issues/330
Review: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/329#discussion_r4613100498
